title: Make a vector
prompt: The robot's position is two numbers, x and y, kept together. Return a Vector2 whose x is x and whose y is y.
starter:
func solve(x, y) -> Vector2:
	return Vector2.ZERO
hints: Vector2 is built by calling it with two values, like a function.

docs.name: Vector2(x, y)
docs.what: Makes a vector holding an x and a y. Read them back with .x and .y.

solution:
func solve(x, y) -> Vector2:
	return Vector2(x, y)
